about: Recorded live from ollama:qwen3.8:27b-mlx in 57 s, 2 model call(s): the goal "Read the sites I follow about a topic, keep only what is new, and write me a short brief into my notes folder.".

request.goal: Read the sites I follow about a topic, keep only what is new, and write me a short brief into my notes folder.
request.name: What is new on my sites

stages.name: Watch my sites
stages.why: Fetches each page you follow about your topic and lists the items on it (title, link, one line, date) as one tidy list.

stages.name: Remember what I've seen
stages.why: Keeps a record of every item earlier runs found, so the next stage can tell what is new from what you already read.

stages.name: What's new
stages.why: Compares today's items with what earlier runs saw and writes a short brief of only the new ones, plus a table of everything seen.

stages.name: Save to my notes
stages.why: Writes the brief as a Markdown file into the notes folder you choose, so it lands where you keep your notes.

recipe.name: What is new on my sites
recipe.description: Reads the sites you follow about a topic, keeps only what is new since the last run, and writes a short brief into your notes folder.

notes_folder.label: Notes folder
notes_folder.description: The folder where the brief is saved as a Markdown file.

saved_brief.label: Saved file
saved_brief.description: The path of the brief written into your notes folder.

stages.name: Save to my notes
stages.why: The brief is written as a Markdown file into the notes folder you choose, so it lands where you keep your notes.
